analysis.instructions:
You are reviewing a recorded playthrough of a 3D game built in the MIX Engine.

# Test: locomotion_0622_000212  (profile: locomotion)
Description: Auto-generated locomotion scenario.

Game under test: MIX Engine demo scene. Locomotion test: walking, strafing, running and turning. Judge ground contact, foot sliding, turn responsiveness, and whether the character starts/stops where the input says.

# What the engine measured (corroborating evidence)
- Duration: 5.0s
- Average FPS: 20.5 (min 4.0, p1 4.0)
- Longest stutter (<30 fps): 200ms over 8 event(s)

# How it FELT (kinesthetic telemetry — the engine's own read)
- Overall feel: 47/100 (rough). The locomotion test feels rough (47/100), floaty, topping out at 4.7 m/s. Responsiveness is the strong point (100). Frame Pacing is weakest (9) — dt CoV 0.79, worst frame 250 ms.
- Responsiveness: 47ms input→motion. Top speed 4.7 m/s, peak accel 4.5 m/s².
  · Responsiveness: 100/100 — median input→motion 47 ms across 1 inputs, 1 produced no motion
  · Snappiness: 18/100 — peak acceleration 7.8 m/s² after input
  · Floatiness: 68/100 — ~1.40 s to coast to a stop (stylistic, not pass/fail)
  · Stability: 40/100 — speed CoV 0.89, 1.2 jitter-flips/s
  · Camera Smoothness: 40/100 — angular jerk 146.1, 0.2 snaps/s
  · Frame Pacing: 9/100 — dt CoV 0.79, worst frame 250 ms
  · Weight: 100/100 — ~1005 ms to reach cruising speed (stylistic)
  · Grip: 50/100 — not enough cornering to measure slip
Cross-check these against the video: if your eyes disagree with a number, say so and trust your eyes.

# Auto-detected anomalies (may be noisy — confirm against the video)
- [medium] t=0.57s low_fps: frame 100 ms
- [medium] t=0.94s low_fps: frame 250 ms
- [medium] t=1.63s low_fps: frame 134 ms
- [medium] t=2.26s low_fps: frame 217 ms

# Your job — evaluate GAME FEEL
Watch the footage and report on responsiveness, movement/physics, camera, animation, collision feedback/juice, pacing, and visual quality. Be specific, cite timestamps, and prioritize what a player would actually notice. Where the telemetry above flags something, confirm or refute it from the video.

Return the structured rubric below.
rubric: FEEL_SCORE: 1-10 (your own, after watching — compare to the engine's number and explain any gap)
ISSUES: bullet list of concrete problems with timestamps (e.g. "0:04 — vehicle slides on turn, no steering response for 0.3s")
SUGGESTIONS: concrete fixes ranked by impact
